cases.title: Register a new account in the browser
cases.expected: A unique account is created and the user lands on their task page
cases.actual: Task page opened with 'Hello, Maya Rao'; exactly one row in users.

cases.title: Duplicate and invalid registration is refused
cases.expected: Clear error message; no second account is created
cases.actual: Duplicate 409 ('An account with this email already exists'), weak password 400, bad email 400.

cases.title: Log out in the browser, then protected pages are closed
cases.expected: Session ends; the old token no longer works; the login form is shown
cases.actual: Login form shown. Old token now gets 401 on /api/tasks.

cases.title: Wrong password in the browser
cases.expected: Login rejected with a clear message and no session created
cases.actual: Message 'Invalid email or password'; no token in the browser.

cases.title: Log in with valid credentials
cases.expected: User is authenticated and reaches the task dashboard
cases.actual: Task dashboard displayed.

cases.title: Create a task from the form
cases.expected: Task is saved and appears in the list; an empty title is refused
cases.actual: Empty title showed 'Title is required.'; valid task appeared in the list.

cases.title: Priority is saved and displayed
cases.expected: Selected priority is shown with the task
cases.actual: 'High priority' shown on the task.

cases.title: Due date entered in local time is stored as UTC
cases.expected: Stored and displayed due date are correct
cases.actual: Entered in IST; database holds UTC 2026-11-07T03:09:00, which converts back to the entered time. Shown as: Due Nov 7, 2026, 8:39 AM

cases.title: Categories are created and reused
cases.expected: Task is linked to the selected categories; existing names are reused
cases.actual: 'college' reused the existing 'College' category; one row in categories.

cases.title: Edit a task
cases.expected: Updated information is saved and displayed correctly
cases.actual: New title and description shown; history row written.

cases.title: Configure a reminder from the form
cases.expected: Configured reminder is stored and shown on the task
cases.actual: Task shows its 'Reminder ...' line; one pending row in reminders.

cases.title: Status change and automatic Overdue
cases.expected: Status is saved and reflected in views; a past due date reads as Overdue
cases.actual: Past-due task showed Overdue; set to Completed through the form; reopened back to Overdue.

cases.title: Complete and reopen with the buttons
cases.expected: Status changes correctly between active and completed
cases.actual: Active -> Completed -> Active, shown in the list each time.

cases.title: Dashboard counts match the task data
cases.expected: Counts equal what the database holds
cases.actual: Active / Overdue / Completed on screen [2, 1, 1] equal the database [2, 1, 1].

cases.title: Search by keyword
cases.expected: Matching tasks are returned; others are excluded
cases.actual: Description keyword found one task; a non-match gave '0 matching tasks'.

cases.title: Filter by status, priority and category
cases.expected: Only matching tasks are displayed
cases.actual: Each filter showed only the matching task; clearing restored all four.

cases.title: Sort by due date, priority and status
cases.expected: The selected order is applied
cases.actual: Priority: ['Submit SE report', 'Old assignment', 'Lab record v2', 'Done already']. Due date: ['Old assignment', 'Submit SE report', 'Lab record v2', 'Done already']. Status: Overdue first, Completed last.

cases.title: Delete needs confirmation
cases.expected: Cancel keeps the task; confirming removes it from every view
cases.actual: 'Keep task' kept it. 'Delete task' removed it from the list and the database.

cases.title: A due reminder becomes a notification without any client request
cases.expected: The background scheduler creates exactly one notification; the badge shows it
cases.actual: Scheduler delivered one notification, once. Badge showed 1, list named the task, 'Mark all as read' cleared it.

cases.title: Preferences are saved and applied to later work
cases.expected: Default priority and sort apply; switching in-app off stops later notifications
cases.actual: Sort and new-task priority followed the saved defaults; reminder fired with no notification while in-app was off.

cases.title: Another user cannot see or change my task
cases.expected: Every cross-user request is refused and recorded; the task is untouched
cases.actual: All 7 request types returned 403; task row unchanged; 7 ACCESS_DENIED events recorded.

cases.title: A task title containing HTML is shown as plain text (stored XSS)
cases.expected: The markup is displayed as text and never runs
cases.actual: Payload displayed literally; no script ran.

cases.title: Administrator manages users; a normal user cannot
cases.expected: Only authorised administrators reach admin functions; deactivation logs the user out
cases.actual: Normal user: no button and 403. Anonymous: 401. Admin deactivated a user: session dead, login 403, action in the log.

cases.title: No JavaScript errors during the whole browser session
cases.expected: The browser reports no uncaught errors
cases.actual: No uncaught JavaScript errors across all flows above.

cases.title: Responsive layout at phone, tablet and desktop widths
cases.expected: No sideways page scroll at 360, 390, 768 and 1280 px; controls stay inside the screen
cases.actual: Overflow px / off-screen controls per width: 360: 0/0, 390: 0/0, 768: 0/0, 1280: 0/0

cases.title: Keyboard-only use of the main flow
cases.expected: Tab reaches the controls, a visible focus style appears, Esc closes a dialog, a task can be created without a mouse
cases.actual: Login, new task, Esc and save all worked with the keyboard. First Tab reached the skip link (focus outline: solid 3px).

cases.title: Accessible names and dark mode
cases.expected: Every visible control has an accessible name; the page follows the system dark setting
cases.actual: Body background rgb(20, 27, 31). No unnamed controls. Row buttons have task-specific names, e.g. 'Delete Buy groceries'.

cases.title: A failed request shows a clear message (temporary network failure)
cases.expected: The user sees an understandable error and no data is lost
cases.actual: Offline: 'Can't reach the server...' and the form stayed open. Online again: the same form saved exactly one task.

cases.title: Inspect stored credentials in the real database file
cases.expected: Only secure salted hashes; no plaintext passwords or session tokens anywhere in the file
cases.actual: Hashes start with scrypt:32768:8:1; two users with one password have different hashes; password and raw token absent from the raw DB and WAL bytes; API never returns the hash.

cases.title: Forged, logged-out and expired tokens are refused
cases.expected: All get 401; protected data is not returned
cases.actual: Forged 401, no token 401, session expired in the database 401, logged out 401.

cases.title: Security events are recorded without secrets
cases.expected: Failed login, success, logout, denied access and admin actions are logged; no passwords or tokens
cases.actual: 43 events of 6 types recorded, with IP addresses; the attempted passwords do not appear; administrators can read them through the API.

cases.title: Repeated failed logins are locked out
cases.expected: After 5 failures the account refuses login, even with the right password
cases.actual: Codes [401, 401, 401, 401, 401, 429]; correct password then 429; the already-open session keeps working.

cases.title: Security headers on real responses; no-store on API data
cases.expected: Headers present on pages and API responses
cases.actual: nosniff, frame DENY, no-referrer, CSP and no-store all present. CSP: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self'; ...

cases.title: SQL injection attempts in login, search, filters and sort
cases.expected: Treated as data or refused; no extra rows returned; no server error
cases.actual: Status codes {'login': 401, 'q': 200, 'cat': 200, 'sort': 400, 'order': 400, 'status': 400}; no other user's data returned; table intact.

cases.title: Fuzz: malformed input gets a clear 4xx
cases.expected: Every malformed request returns a 4xx in the standard error format
cases.actual: All 19 probes returned a 4xx with the standard error body.

cases.title: Boundary input: huge task id in URL
cases.expected: A controlled 4xx (or a normal success); never a 500
cases.actual: HTTP 404 NOT_FOUND

cases.title: Boundary input: huge offset in query
cases.expected: A controlled 4xx (or a normal success); never a 500
cases.actual: HTTP 400 VALIDATION_ERROR

cases.title: Boundary input: minutesBefore = 1e999 (infinity)
cases.expected: A controlled 4xx (or a normal success); never a 500
cases.actual: HTTP 400 VALIDATION_ERROR

cases.title: Boundary input: date at year 1 with an offset
cases.expected: A controlled 4xx (or a normal success); never a 500
cases.actual: HTTP 400 VALIDATION_ERROR

cases.title: Boundary input: date at year 9999 with an offset
cases.expected: A controlled 4xx (or a normal success); never a 500
cases.actual: HTTP 400 VALIDATION_ERROR

cases.title: Boundary input: lone surrogate in title
cases.expected: A controlled 4xx (or a normal success); never a 500
cases.actual: HTTP 400 VALIDATION_ERROR

cases.title: Boundary input: lone surrogate in password at login
cases.expected: A controlled 4xx (or a normal success); never a 500
cases.actual: HTTP 400 VALIDATION_ERROR

cases.title: Boundary input: lone surrogate in search
cases.expected: A controlled 4xx (or a normal success); never a 500
cases.actual: HTTP 200

cases.title: Boundary input: huge reminder id
cases.expected: A controlled 4xx (or a normal success); never a 500
cases.actual: HTTP 404 NOT_FOUND

cases.title: Boundary input: due date at year 1, reminder before it
cases.expected: A controlled 4xx (or a normal success); never a 500
cases.actual: HTTP 400 VALIDATION_ERROR

cases.title: Boundary input: JSON nested 12000 levels deep
cases.expected: A controlled 4xx (or a normal success); never a 500
cases.actual: HTTP 400 VALIDATION_ERROR

cases.title: Boundary input: emoji and Kannada text (must still be accepted)
cases.expected: A controlled 4xx (or a normal success); never a 500
cases.actual: HTTP 201

cases.title: The application still works after all the bad input
cases.expected: Health is ok and the user's data is unchanged
cases.actual: Health ok; base task unchanged.

cases.title: Dashboard response time under normal load
cases.expected: 95th percentile at most 3 seconds
cases.actual: 1000 requests from 10 concurrent clients, 500 tasks per user: p50 20 ms, p95 33 ms, max 47 ms, 0 errors.

cases.title: Search and filter response time under normal load
cases.expected: 95th percentile at most 3 seconds
cases.actual: 500 requests from 10 concurrent clients (up to 100 tasks per response): p50 35 ms, p95 64 ms, max 92 ms, 0 errors.

cases.title: Simultaneous writes from many clients
cases.expected: Every confirmed create is stored once, with its history; no 'database is locked' errors
cases.actual: 200 creates from 20 threads: 200 returned 201, 200 new task rows, 200 history rows.

cases.title: HTTP is redirected to HTTPS when FORCE_HTTPS is on
cases.expected: 301 to the https:// address
cases.actual: 301, Location: https://127.0.0.1:53869/api/health

cases.title: Traffic is really encrypted with `run.py --https`
cases.expected: A real TLS handshake succeeds, HSTS is sent over HTTPS, and plain HTTP is not served on that port
cases.actual: TLSv1.3 handshake OK; HSTS sent; plain HTTP not served on that port. Partial because the certificate is self-signed: a trusted certificate and reverse proxy exist only in a deployment (D12).

cases.title: Server killed abruptly (kill -9): confirmed data survives
cases.expected: After a restart every confirmed change is present and the database passes its integrity check
cases.actual: All 24 remaining tasks, the edit, the completion and the delete survived; the session token stayed valid; integrity_check ok; no foreign-key violations.

cases.title: Availability: health check and recovery
cases.expected: Health endpoint reports status; monthly uptime of at least 99.5%
cases.actual: Health returns 200 with database ok; back up 0.2 s after a kill and restart. NOT measured: the 99.5% monthly figure needs a deployed system monitored for a month (D13).

cases.title: Server log contains no passwords or session tokens
cases.expected: The test passwords and bearer tokens do not appear in the application log
cases.actual: 2167 log lines scanned: no passwords, no tokens. Tracebacks logged: 0 (from the boundary-input defects, if any).
